semiconductor_relevance: High — Nikon TEC is a key supplier of advanced photolithography equipment essential for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Nikon TEC specializes in high-precision photolithography equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Their systems support advanced process technologies, including DUV and EUV lithography, crucial for the production of integrated circuits. The company also offers support services and software solutions to enhance fabrication efficiency.
capabilities: Comprehensive support services and software solutions
